title: E0034: intdiv() Overflow
plain_english: Reports `intdiv()` calls that can overflow for `PHP_INT_MIN / -1`.
why_matters: `intdiv(PHP_INT_MIN, -1)` overflows integer arithmetic in PHP and causes a runtime error. This rule uses Phanalist's bounded formal verification engine (Z3-backed) to detect feasible paths that reach this case.
bad_example:
<?php
function overflow(): int
{
    return intdiv(PHP_INT_MIN, -1); // overflow
}
good_example:
<?php
function safeIntDiv(int $a, int $b): int
{
    if ($b === 0) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Division by zero');
    }
    if ($a === PHP_INT_MIN && $b === -1) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException('Overflow');
    }

    return intdiv($a, $b);
}
what_it_checks: Symbolic dividends and divisors whose feasible values reach the overflow case
Guarded calls and bounded integer ranges
Constant-return, identity, and PHPDoc method/function summaries
